title: Multi-step Form
subtitle: Wizard UI over one resource draft
description: One Resource, several steps. Validate the current step before advancing; save on the last step.
content: Keep a single draft across steps so Back does not lose data. Persist draft if users may refresh mid-wizard.

sections.title: Why validateFields?
sections.content: Full `validate()` would fail later steps that are still empty. Step navigation should only check the active paths, then `save()` runs full validation on Finish.
